title: uncraftable stairs
description: adds reciepies to de-craft stairs into blocks
body:
📦 What does this datapack do?
In vanilla Minecraft, stairs are crafted from 6 blocks → 4 stairs.
This datapack adds the reverse recipe:
👉 4 stairs → 6 corresponding blocks

Now you can recover your materials without any loss.

📜 Example recipes:

![planks example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bd06980718be862a051fd94dcde0929972fd2c0.png)
![crymson planks example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3220ff163ac1847031cb2b2fab04d6d6a1cf64b9.png)
![tuff bricks example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30b50d3d0721718c240d9e899bb712f53ffa922c.png)
![cutt copper example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ac92b0c528cff19bcaf12118503553bd5be9550.png)

🔧 Features:
✅ Works for all stair types (wood, stone, sandstone, quartz, nether, prismarine, bamboo, cherry, etc.)

✅ Does not break balance — simply returns the original blocks

✅ Perfect for servers where resources matter

✅ Works without any crafting table (standard 2×2 grid)

🧩 How to install:
Download the .zip file (or the folder containing data/)

Place it into the datapacks folder of your world:
.minecraft/saves/YourWorldName/datapacks/

Reload the world or run the command /reload

Open a crafting table — the recipes will appear automatically

💡 Why use this?
Dismantle unwanted stairs from your builds

Fix block miscalculations during construction

Get more blocks for other crafts

Useful in resource-limited modpacks

❗ Note:
This datapack does not replace the original stair recipe (6→4), it adds the reverse one (4→6).
